jobs.prompt:
Opus review of the auto-approve port (tools/auto-approve-policy.mjs and its hook in tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/handbuild-guard.mjs, tools/self-approval.mjs) returned FAIL. Fix every finding below, add a test per finding to tests/auto-approve.test.mjs, keep the other guard and approval tests passing. Prefer REMOVING capability over parsing it: the supported set becomes only git add of swarm-produced files, plain git commit -m MSG, git push origin BRANCH, git switch and git switch -c on allowed-prefix branches, and git status, diff and log. Orchestrator mode must still gain nothing.
1 HIGH the guard throws the policy git verdict away: in handbuild.mjs, both branches after policyGitInvocationRule do 'policyGitOps.push(push); continue', skipping the existing push protections (force, delete, mirror, protected branches) and ignoring a denied result; handbuildPolicyGuardCheck receives policyOps, a different variable from policyGitOps, neither declared in the diff, and only checks entries shaped {tool:'git', sub}, so plain strings are dropped and gitOps comes back empty (returns ok); when an owner approval and a policy approval are both live finishAllow picks the owner row and skips the policy checks. Fix: a denied verdict denies; build ONE declared list of parsed {tool, sub, rest} objects and pass it to the policy check; always run the policy check whenever a policy approval was used, even if an owner approval is also live.
2 HIGH the origin check accepts any URL: projectRepositoryUrls adds origin's own URL to the trusted list so the match is always true; the comparison accepts suffix matches either way; ssh-form parsing drops the host; the trusted URL comes from .project-swarm.json which agents can edit. Fix: the trusted repository URL lives only in owner-only machine config (the approval policy file under the user's config dir), compare exact normalized host and path, check every result of git remote get-url --push --all origin, and refuse when the origin pushurl setting or any url insteadOf or pushInsteadOf rewrite exists.
3 HIGH environment and wrappers: nothing rejects GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_SSH_COMMAND, the GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, KEY and VALUE variables, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, nor env, sh -c, cd ... && wrappers; branchOf, headOf and the origin check run with the hook's own environment. Fix: on the policy path refuse any command with an environment assignment, a wrapper, chaining, a cd, or a git -C or --git-dir or --work-tree option; run all policy git queries with a cleaned environment (only PATH and HOME) and cwd set to the command's real working directory.
4 MEDIUM git remote and git config writes and .git/config edits can redirect pushes (the origin push mapping, push.default, aliases): refuse git remote and git config during a window and refuse pushes unless refs/heads/X:refs/heads/X style explicit mapping is used internally by the hook (the command stays git push origin BRANCH but the hook verifies no push mapping config exists).
5 MEDIUM git hooks bypass commit rules: block session writes to .git folder and require core.hooksPath unset and the hooks directory to hold only .sample files at execution time.
6 MEDIUM branch and HEAD are read from the project root, not where the command runs (gitWorktreePolicyContext defaults cwd to root): resolve branch, HEAD, remote and clean-tree status from the command's real working directory.
7 MEDIUM rate limits fail open: an unreadable, missing, corrupt or symlinked stats.json reads as {} and resets counters; stats.json, log.ndjson and auto-off are protected only in the orchestrator write list. Fix: an unreadable stats file means limit reached; protect these three files from writes, deletes and renames in every mode.
8 MEDIUM the kill switch and approved ops are not re-checked at execution: check the auto-off kill switch and that the git subcommand is in the window's approved list inside the guard check.
9 MEDIUM scopes too wide: take .project-swarm.json and the coordination manifests folder out of the auto-approvable files; job manifest files under jobs must be .json only; resolve the deepest existing folder (symlinks) for files that do not exist yet; remove worktree add from the supported set; switch uses an allow-list of flags (none), not a ban list.
10 LOW binding to HEAD closes the window at the first commit so commit then push never works: bind to the branch name and the HEAD ancestry (new HEAD must descend from the granted HEAD); add a hard ceiling for policy.json limits; anchor the SAFE_SWARM handbuild stats pattern; wire or drop the documented 'swarm handbuild stats --json'.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: guard and approval tests in context; full suite before merge
